assertion.name: Patient-specific hiPSC-derived airway epithelium model
assertion.description: Human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived airway epithelium differentiated at air-liquid interface to model structural ciliary defects and impaired mucociliary transport in genetically defined primary ciliary dyskinesia.
assertion.cell_source: Patient-specific induced pluripotent stem cell lines differentiated into ciliated airway epithelium
assertion.culture_system: Air-liquid interface differentiation of hiPSC-derived airway epithelium

findings.statement: Patient-specific hiPSC-derived airway epithelium reproduces molecular, ultrastructural, and functional ciliary defects, including impaired mucociliary transport

modeled_mechanisms.description: DNAH5 and NME5 patient-derived hiPSC airway epithelia reproduce their respective structural and functional ciliary defects.
modeled_mechanisms.limitations: Two patient-specific lines do not establish fidelity across PCD genotypes, reprogramming clones or differentiation batches.

readouts.name: Ciliary motility and ultrastructure
readouts.description: Electron microscopy, immunofluorescence and beat-frequency measurements assess two patient-specific hiPSC lines.

modeled_mechanisms.description: Patient-specific hiPSC airway epithelia reproduce impaired culture-surface transport.
modeled_mechanisms.limitations: The measured culture phenotype does not establish prediction of individual clinical severity or whole-lung clearance.

readouts.name: Mucociliary transport
readouts.description: Transport measurements complement structural and beat-frequency phenotyping of DNAH5 and NME5 cultures.

selected_evidence.snippet: Motile cilia dysfunction results in diminished mucociliary clearance (MCC) of pathogens in the respiratory tract and chronic airway inflammation and infections successively causing progressive lung damage.

assertion.name: BCi-NS1.1 dyskinetic airway epithelial cell line
assertion.description: The reported BCi-NS1.1 culture had slow circular ciliary beating and a central-microtubule defect confirmed by electron microscopy. This is a phenotypic model for ciliary modulation, not a genotype-defined patient model or an automatically normal airway control.
assertion.cell_source: Immortalized human bronchial epithelial BCi-NS1.1 cell line
assertion.culture_system: Air-liquid interface differentiation

modeled_mechanisms.description: Reproduces dyskinetic circular ciliary beating in the reported cell-line culture.
modeled_mechanisms.limitations: No causal patient PCD genotype is established. The report concerns the tested stock and culture conditions; it does not establish identical behavior in all BCi-NS1.1 stocks or prove that immortalization caused the defect.

readouts.name: Circular ciliary beat pattern
readouts.description: High-speed video detects circular dyskinetic motion, with a corresponding ultrastructural defect.

selected_evidence.snippet: Although changes in CBF induced by known modulators were as expected, the cilia displayed a dyskinetic, circular beat pattern characteristic of central microtubular agenesis with outer doublet transposition.

assertion.name: CCDC40 mRNA replacement in patient airway cultures
assertion.description: Lipid nanoparticle CCDC40 mRNA was tested in nasal ALI cultures from five CCDC40-deficient individuals, restoring expression in 10–74% of ciliated cells, associated axonemal proteins, beating and particle transport. Parallel zebrafish olfactory-pit flow rescue is preclinical vertebrate evidence. The study proposes a human phase I trial; it does not report clinical efficacy.

modeled_mechanisms.description: mRNA replacement restores CCDC40 and integration of associated axonemal proteins.
modeled_mechanisms.limitations: The measured culture phenotype does not establish prediction of individual clinical severity or whole-lung clearance.

readouts.name: Axonemal protein reconstitution

modeled_mechanisms.description: Treatment improves fluorescent-particle transport in patient cultures.
modeled_mechanisms.limitations: The measured culture phenotype does not establish prediction of individual clinical severity or whole-lung clearance.

readouts.name: Fluorescent-particle transport after mRNA delivery

assertion.culture_system: Air-liquid interface culture treated with lipid nanoparticle-formulated CCDC40 mRNA

assertion.cell_source: Patient-derived nasal inferior turbinate epithelial cells expanded as airway organoids
assertion.culture_system: Long-term expandable airway organoid culture with ciliated differentiation

findings.statement: Patient-derived airway organoids reproduce mutation-linked differences in ciliary beating and support genotype-specific functional interrogation

modeled_mechanisms.description: Differentiated patient airway organoids retain mutation-associated ciliary beating abnormalities.
modeled_mechanisms.limitations: Expansion and ciliated differentiation were demonstrated in a small genotype panel. Closed organoid geometry and culture composition limit extrapolation to airway transport; molecular editing alone is not evidence of functional rescue.

readouts.name: Patient-specific ciliary beating

selected_evidence.snippet: We apply this condition to AOs established from nasal inferior turbinate brush samples of patients suffering from primary ciliary dyskinesia (PCD), a pulmonary disease caused by dysfunction of the motile cilia in the airways.

value.name: Homozygous GDAP1 Ser194Ter patient-derived motor neurons
value.description: Motor neurons from one homozygous Ser194Ter CMT2H patient were compared with two unrelated controls. Lower GDAP1 mRNA/protein, perturbed cristae and increased MitoSOX signal were observed; significance for MitoSOX was reached versus one control only. ATP content was not significantly different, which does not establish normal respiratory flux. Lower DAPI cell yield occurred during differentiation, and electron-dense structures were suspected rather than confirmed lipid droplets. Nonsense-mediated decay and apoptosis were proposed without direct demonstration. This is a recessive comparison model with no isogenic rescue.

value.name: Rat sensory neurons expressing full-length GDAP1 variants
value.description: Full-length WT, R120W and H123R were overexpressed in primary rat sensory neurons. The study found no apparent difference in staining intensity/localization, distinguishable gross morphology or toxicity. Nonreducing cellular SDS gels support absence of stable disulfide-linked dimers under those assay conditions, not absence of all native noncovalent dimers.

assertion.description: The culture expresses full-length disease variants and delineates negative gross cellular findings.
assertion.limitations: Not an endogenous human heterozygous neuron or a sensitive test of long-term axonal degeneration; no fusion assay was reported in this culture.

selected_evidence.snippet: No apparent difference in the immunostaining intensity or cellular localization of R120W or H123R was observed compared with wtGDAP1. None of the mutations induced distinguishable morphological changes in sensory neurons, and no cell toxic effects were observed

value.name: Dominant GDAP1 patient fibroblast redox and respiration study
value.description: Six patient lines came from two unrelated families: three C240Y and three R120W. Available lines and controls varied by assay. Complex-I-substrate respiration and ATP synthesis were lower in both groups, but direct complex I enzyme and oxidative-stress abnormalities were clearest in C240Y. Complex I assembly and NDUFB8 abundance were preserved; SIRT1/NRF1 abundance decreased without a mediation experiment. Resveratrol treatment for 48 hours improved pooled complex I activity at 25 micromolar; 10 micromolar had no significant effect and 50 micromolar was antiproliferative. No clinical benefit or universal GST-domain severity rule was demonstrated.

assertion.description: C240Y fibroblasts had reduced complex I enzyme activity.
assertion.limitations: Only two families; R120W enzyme-activity reduction was nonsignificant. No isogenic correction.

value.name: Gdap1-null primary motor and sensory neuron cultures
value.description: Embryonic motor neurons and adult dorsal-root-ganglion sensory neurons from exon1-null mice were cultured. Altered mitochondrial morphology/distribution and reduced alpha-tubulin acetylation were observed. Fura-2 assays in motor neurons showed lower resting cytosolic calcium and reduced store-operated entry. These culture findings do not directly measure in-vivo calcium, axonal transport velocity or a dominant allele effect.
Cultured null motor neurons show a reduced SOCE response.

value.name: Isogenic iPSC adipocyte-hepatocyte-macrophage microphysiological system (M1-iADIPO-iHEP-MPS)
value.description: A fluidically interconnected multi-tissue New Approach Methodology for the adipose tissue-liver axis, built entirely from one human induced pluripotent stem cell line so that adipocytes, hepatocytes and macrophages are isogenic and donor genotype is not a confounder. White adipocyte and hepatocyte chambers are linked by circulating media at 20 microlitres per hour; proinflammatory (M1) macrophages are added to the adipocyte chamber to impose white adipose tissue inflammation. value.name: Isogenic iPSC macrophage-adipocyte microphysiological system (iMAC-iADIPO-MPS)
value.description: The adipose half of the platform, used on its own to model chronic white adipose tissue inflammation. iPSC-derived macrophages migrate into three-dimensional adipocyte clusters and form crown-like structures around damaged adipocytes, reproducing the defining histology of obese human adipose tissue; the number of such structures rises with adipocyte age and with palmitic acid exposure, so inflammatory severity is gradable. value.name: Selected ADCL1 patient dermal fibroblast cultures
value.cell_source: Cultures from CL 1, CL 3 and CL 4 among six individuals/five probands in the 2011 series
value.description: Nonisogenic patient fibroblasts and age/sex/passage-matched controls were compared for elastin deposition, splicing and signaling. Reduced insoluble elastin and abnormal deposition accompanied allele-dependent intracellular effects. CL 1 lacked the measured stress response; CL 4 mainly increased BiP; CL 3 showed BiP, phospho-eIF2alpha and cleaved-caspase3 changes. Increased pSMAD2 was observed across all three tested patient cultures.
value.notes: Not all six clinical participants supplied the mechanistic cultures. Biopsy sites differ, there is no allele correction or selective stress/TGF-beta rescue, and measured insoluble elastin does not establish crosslink density per molecule. Co-occurrence does not prove an obligatory retention→ER stress→apoptosis chain.
